description: Pinned, reproducible build toolchain for the native Linux OS shape. The SLeeLa OS Creator provisions this environment and runs linux/build-shape.sh to compile the kernel and assemble a bootable root filesystem into an installable artifact. Base matches the Ubuntu 24.04.4 rootfs this shape ships.

hostBase.rationale: x86_64 Linux host matching the Ubuntu 24.04.4 base rootfs warehoused under os-loader; the kernel and userland build natively here.

requires.notes: make defconfig (or x86_64_defconfig) then make -j; output arch/x86/boot/bzImage. Modules install to INSTALL_MOD_PATH.

The base rootfs tarball (ubuntu-base-24.04.4-base-amd64.tar.gz) is extracted, then the remaining packages (kernel image, systemd, GRUB, initramfs-tools) are apt-installed INSIDE a chroot. This is the native apt step for the Linux shape (see linux/provision/provision.json).

orchestrator.emits: kernel -> bzImage; rootfs -> an assembled Ubuntu root filesystem; iso -> a bootable installable image.
